label: NATURAL_REASON_2: A fideist re-reading of 'NATURAL_REASON_2': the reasoning that counts as natural…
definition: A fideist re-reading of 'natural reason': the reasoning that counts as natural within the religious practice's own grammar, whose correctness answers only to that practice's standards. Under it, a move affirming natural knowability of God need not answer to reason shared with outsiders.
note: Recorded for contrast only (#1010): no source asserts this reading of Dei Filius; TruthCore.Results.Alternatives.FideismCatholicPractice.needsNaturalReasonIsShared certifies survival of the old fideist bundle when the shared bridge is omitted, not the whole original internal interpretation. Owner fork (2026-11-09): internal sufficiency (shared standards may agree) and absence of external authority are explicit analyst siblings, not a conjunction or a settled mapping for this original reconstruction. Sufficiency scope and one-way versus biconditional strength remain visible parameters/versions. The original stays unbound pending exact mapping, coverage and reading selection; no allowance removed. The old omission countermodel does not certify exclusive authority. See ATTEMPT-LUMEN-NATURALE-WITNESSES-1010 for inventory and rejected shortcuts.
